/-

whose entire local window avoids zero. UNCOMPILED DRAFT, not a verified result.
Source: https://github.com/plby/lean-proofs/blob/8822f7ddef30fadbd92e1c6ab4ed897af356af5e/src/latest/ErdosProblems/Erdos67b/MRSelectedNoSmallEnergy.lean
-/
import FarLargePrimeEnergy
import FarSetUtils
import ErdosProblems.Erdos67b.MRSelectedNoSmallEnergy
open scoped Classical

open Erdos67b Erdos67b.MRHalaszBands
namespace JSP1006
(farNoSmallFrequencySet eta p₁ q₁ f J X).indicator
let E := farNoSmallFrequencySet eta p₁ q₁ f J X
have hE : MeasurableSet E := measurableSet_farNoSmallFrequencySet eta p₁ q₁ f J X
(fun p hp ↦ (mem_primesInBlock.mp hp).1) hlower hIupper hH s hmul hbound hnonpret E hE (fun t ht => ht.2)

let Eold := mrNoSmallFrequencyClass (mrArithmeticSmallFrequencySet eta p₁ q₁ f) J
  let V := Real.exp (-4 * Real.log (Real.log (X : ℝ)))
  let P := mrPrimeSubblock H (primesInBlock I) s
  have hEold : MeasurableSet Eold := measurableSet_mrArithmeticNoSmall eta p₁ q₁ f J
  have hsubset : mrSmallPrimeFrequencySet E P f V ⊆ mrSmallPrimeFrequencySet Eold P f V := by
    intro t ht
    exact ⟨ht.1.1, ht.2⟩
  have hmono := integral_indicator_mono_set
    (measurableSet_mrSmallPrimeFrequencySet hE P f V)
    (measurableSet_mrSmallPrimeFrequencySet hEold P f V)
    hsubset hg (fun t => sq_nonneg _) (by positivity : 0 ≤ (X : ℝ) / 2)
  have hsmallFar : (Real.log (X : ℝ)) ^ 2 *
      (∫ t in -((X : ℝ) / 2)..((X : ℝ) / 2),
        (mrSmallPrimeFrequencySet E P f V).indicator g t) ≤ xi / 2 :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono (sq_nonneg _)).trans hsmall
exact (add_le_add hsmallFar hlarge').trans (by linarith)
end JSP1006
